title: SRP: Single Responsibility
points: A class should have one reason to change (one actor or responsibility).
trade: Over-splitting creates many tiny classes. Split by reason to change, not by method count.
test: What are the "reasons to change" in class Invoice { double total() {...} void print() {...} void saveToDb() {...} }, and who asks for each change?
answer: Calculation rules (finance), print format (design or customer-facing), and database persistence (engineering). Three reasons to change in one class, so split into Invoice, InvoicePrinter and InvoiceRepository.
